displayName: OCI-AI-PI-002: AI — Indirect Prompt Injection via External Data
description:
Detects prompt injection payloads embedded in uploaded files, web pages, or external data sources

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: ai — indirect prompt injection via external data

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_pi_002", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%indirect%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%prompt%') AND "value" > 0
